notes.title: Updates: Expanded Map
notes.content:
Update 0.2.4

[h1]Expanded Map[/h1]
We've Expanded the map with a new highway zone, park, parking deck, and a few more blocks.

[h1]Improved Visuals and Effect[/h1]
We've reworked the visual stylings to make the colors, reflections and effects really pop.

[h1]New Allies[/h1] 
We've added an allied tank  and a new CyberThreat soldier in FreePlay.

[h1]Improved Performance[/h1]  - We've worked hard to further optimize performance across the engine.

[h1]Improved Teleportation[/h1]
Teleportation has been improved. One big improvement is to re-orient it to match the weapon line of sight. This allows you to more easily keep your weapon trained on the enemy as you advance.

[h1] Experimental Features[/h1]
We're testing a few new experimental features that can be enabled from the Options menu:
[list]
[*][b]Riding[/b] - Turn this on to allow the player to move with items they are standing on. For instance jump on the back of a tank to hitch a ride. It's also fun to stand on top of a light pole and then ride it down as it is destroyed. This is a preview of vehicle support we have coming soon. This may be a bit much for those who are prone to motion sickness so we've made it optional and would like to hear your feedback.
[*][b]Tank Control[/b] - Enable this and the Ride option and then hop on the back of a battle tank. Grab the machine gun handle and your hands will turn into tank controls. One hand will control the machine gun and the other will control the main gun. Squeeze the grip and tilt your hand to steer the tank. You can also jump off the the tank and control it remotely after you've taken control. We're still refining these controls but wanted to get your feedback.
[*][b]Hardlight Suit Support[/b] - If you have a Hardlight suit from Hardlight VR ([url=http://www.hardlightvr.com/]http://www.hardlightvr.com/[/url]) enable this to feel the impacts and explosions. As with the other experimental features, this is a work in progress, so feedback is appreciated. 
[/list]

notes.title: Rocket Launcher Upgraded
notes.content:
[h1]Rocket Launcher Upgraded[/h1]
Is your Rocket Launcher running out of ammo? Well now it is not a problem. Your rocket launcher will replenish its supply of rockets every 10 seconds up to 3 shots. You can still pick-up rocket packs to boost the total even further.

[h1]Cinematic Camera Session Only[/h1]
To prevent having it be inadvertently on, we've changed the cinematic camera to be on only for the current game session. 

[h1]Arm Running[/h1]
Adjusted the balance to make arm running smoother and jumping easier.

[h1]Hide Movement Panel[/h1]
We've added an option to hide the movement panel that shows at launch.

[i]Update 0.2.3[/i]

notes.title: Extreme Parkour
notes.content:
[h1]Extreme Parkour[/h1]
We're incredibly excited about the new version of our parkour system. All actions are completely automatic. Simply swing your arms to start running. Swing them together to jump. Walk up to a wall and stick your hand in to climb. No button presses involved. 

If you are holding onto a surface when climbing, simply click the trigger on that hand to disengage.

The new Parkour system delivers a new level of immersion into the game.

[h1]Control Changes[/h1]
On the Vive we've remapped weapon switching to the Menu button. To pause the game hold the Menu button down for one second.

[h1]Clankers Are Now Destructible[/h1]
Disassemble them piece by piece with your guns or all at once with a well-plced rocket or grenade.

[h1]Grenades[/h1]
We will be adding more explosives and ways of carrying them, but we wanted to allow you to start playing with them sooner, so we sprinkled grenades through the Campaign, Night Patrol and Free Play levels.

[h1]Heal Allied Soldiers[/h1]
If an allied soldier has been killed by the clankers, simply touch them with the palm of your hand to revive them. This can be particularly helpful on harder levels and it gives you a bonus if they are alive at the end of the level.

[h1]Improved AI[/h1]
We've improved the AI to improve performance and to help them hone in on you even faster.

[h1]Improved Secondary Weapon Grip[/h1]
We've enhanced the visibility of the secondary weapons grip and worked to minimize accidental triggers.

[h1]Cinematic/Selfie Camera[/h1]
We've enhanced the cinematic camera which now adds a touchpad controls on your left hand to change follow mode and camera distance as well as providing a view from the camera so you can see what your audience sees. Touch the left our right side of the camera control to move it in or out. Press down on the top of the touchpad to toggle the camera mode, or on the bottom to return to the through the eyes view.

[h1]New Allied Drone[/h1]
We've added a new drone model, but this time it is on your side. Keep an eye out for it in Free Play. We plan to allow a friend to take control of it and join you in the game in the future.

Numerous other fixes and enhancements.

- Update 0.2.2

notes.title: More Shrapnel & Languages
notes.content:
[h1]Enhanced Shrapnel Effects[/h1]
We've amped up the intensity and realism by adding particles and debris that fly off as bullets impact into the environment. 

[h1]New Language Support[/h1]
Added support for 6 additional languages including Chinese-Simplified, Chinese-Traditional, French, German, Japanese and Spanish. 
We have quite a few changes in-store for the game, so the current translations are temporary. If you notice any issues or would like to help out with the existing languages or another language email us and let us know.

[h1]Numerous Performance Improvements[/h1]

[h1]We Need Your Help[/h1]
We are working as hard as we can to build out the world of CyberThreat. However, as you you may have heard, VR titles generally aren't yet delivering the sales numbers to justify the investment needed to support development. 

[h1]How Can You Help?[/h1]

[b]Get the Word Out[/b]
Spread the word about CyberThreat by leaving a review, telling your friends, mentioning it on forums, posting a Youtube video or streaming it on Twitch. When you do share it, let us know so we can feature it as well.

[b]Provide Feedback[/b]
Let us know what you think about the game and anything we can do to improve it. We love hearing from you!

[b]Beta Testing[/b]
We'll be releasing a sign-up form in the next few weeks for those who are interested in helping to beta test some of our upcoming features including multiplayer, Twitch streaming features, new level expansions and game modes.

- Update 0.2.1

notes.title: New Menu & Twitch Chat
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004776/c21893cb06d42f8042e79fd21cdef29ee50a0524.png[/img]
We're working on a massive update, but wanted to get some of the improvements out to you now. Here's what's new in version 0.2.0:

[h1]New Interface[/h1]
We've redesigned the interface to make it easier to get into the action. 
[list]
[*]Launch Free Play directly from the Main Menu
[*]Quick Continue option for the campaign
[*]New Mission Complete screen
[*]New Options Menu - Adds additional features
[/list]

[h1]New Campaign Level - Titan[/h1]
We've added a new campaign level featuring the all-new Titan Mech. This beast will take all your skill to bring down and it's brought along a few friends.

[h1]Demo Mode - Ouroboros[/h1]
Demo mode can be launched from the Main Menu using the Ouroboros button or use a hotkey pressing 4. We've made some improvements to it with additional enemies and better camera follow.

[h1]Explore Mode[/h1]
Want to try out the weapons and explore the city without enemies? Then explore mode is for you. Press 0 to launch.

[h1]Launch Hot Keys[/h1]
Showing it to your friends, use the new hot keys to jump them into the action.
[b]Keys:
1 - Freeplay - Easy
2 - Freeplay - Medium
3 - Freeplay - Hard
4 - Demo/Ouroboros mode
0 - Explore Mode
f - Toggle Full Screen[/b]

[h1]New Social Features - Experimental[/h1]
We've added Twitch chat integration. Simply enter your twitch channel name and you can see the chat messages in VR. We've added several location options. 

We've also added an improved Cinematic Camera mode which is perfect for streaming. You can now see the camera in VR which allows you to gesture to it. 

[h1]Massive Performance Improvements[/h1]
We've made huge gains across the board. 

[h1]New Indoor Spaces[/h1]
As a preview of future enhancements, we've added two more indoor spaces. We've also enhanced the existing spaces by making the glass breakable on the windows.

[h1]Numerous other improvements.[/h1]

[h1]What's coming?[/h1]
This release is a preview of what we have in the works.
[list]
[*]Oculus SDK Build
[*]Increasing the map size from 14 to 27 city blocks
[*]Adding highway and elevated train areas
[*]Adding underground areas - subways and sewers
[*]Adding numerous more indoor spaces from apartments to shops to offices
[*]A new inventory system which will allow you to purchase weapons and upgrades with experience
[*]All new campaign and challenge missions
[*]New enemies and allies
[*]New weapons
[*]New Player Items: Grenades, bots, bombs, devices
[*]Multiplayer mode
[*]More social features
[*]And More!
[/list]

notes.title: New: Flamethrower
notes.content:
[h1]New Weapon: Flamethrower![/h1]
Available as part of Night Patrol and unlockable in Open World once you reach 350k.

[h1]Two New Enemies: Flame Turret and Dragon Drone[/h1]
Flame turrets are tough foes and incredibly deadly for human allies. 

The dragon drones are one of the most terrifying enemies in the game. They will pursue you without mercy and you won't last long under their fiery breath. Take them down with prejudice at first sight.

[h1]6 New Missions: Night Patrol[/h1]
Take a enemy stronghold, run the fire gauntlet and battle dragons in this brand new expansion.

[h1]Zoom Teleport[/h1]
Zoom teleport moves you to your destination rather than blinking. It can help improve location awareness over instantaneous teleport. You can enable it in options. We've left this as option for now since it may be too intense for users who are subject to motion sickness.

[h1]Forward Arrow[/h1]

notes.title: Oculus Touch
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004776/65bd824772c79a6eaab50066a4a9a6c9898b77c4.png[/img]

[h1]0.1.0 Oculus Touch Support[/h1]
The public SteamVR beta has limited support for Oculus Touch, so we've also added support for the Beta version. 

[b]Steam VR Public Features[/b]
The default layout is limited by the current public version of Steam VR. The Y and B buttons are used for the Steam overlay. A and X are used for menus. The grip button changes the weapon.

[b]Steam VR Beta Features[/b]
If you install the Steam VR Beta version, turn on the Steam VR Beta option in the options panel. Steam has moved the Steam Overlay to the left menu button. That allows us to use the  Y and B buttons for menus, and A and X buttons for switching weapons. The Steam VR beta also enables haptic feedback.

[b]How to get the Steam VR Beta[/b]
To opt-in to the SteamVR Beta branch, right-click on SteamVR in your Steam Library and choose Properties. Go to the Beta tab and choose "beta - SteamVR Beta Update" from the drop-down. If SteamVR is turned off, it will update with the beta. To turn return to the normal version, follow the same process, but choose "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs".
	
Once the the new SteamVR update has been release out of beta, we release an update to make that the standard choice.

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Change Weapon has been Moved to Grip for Vive and A or X Button for Touch
[*]Menu Button only controls Menu or Pause as before	
[*]Added Snap Turn Option - When enabled use touchpad on Vive or Joystick on Touch to turn in 45 degree increments.
[*]Added Difficulty Levels to Open World
[*]Updated with Holiday Theme
[*]Added Secondary Grip - Added to both assault rifle and sniper rifle allowing steadying with the second hand
[*]Background Action in Main Menu - Demo Mode has been enabled in the Main Menu filling the world with activity. If you enter Explore mode, you can shoot them, but they won't target you.
[*]Numerous other enhancements
[/list]

Background Action in Main Menu - Demo Mode has been enabled in the Main Menu filling the world with activity. If you enter Explore mode, you can shoot them, but they won't target you.

notes.title: What's New in Version 0.0.8
notes.content:
[b]Climbing[/b] - Go up to a building and when you see a orange glow around your hand, you can grab it using the trigger and pull yourself up. It even works on fences and other static objects. 

[b]Grabbing[/b] - Grabbable items are indicated by a blue glow around your hands. Simply squeeze the trigger to grab them.

[b]Jumping[/b] - Look in the direction you'd like to go, hold the Grip buttons on Both controllers and move your arms down and release. You must be grounded to use, so you can't use it while using the jetpack.

[b]Released The Cars[/b] - Cars are now fully movable before being destroyed. You can also more easily pick them up and their pieces using the trigger button. 

[b]Improved Teleportation[/b] - The teleport system will wrap around the environment making it easier to get into cover.

[b]Numerous New Atmospheric Sounds[/b] - Now hear bullets whizzing buy your head and impacting around you.

[b]Updated Touchpad Movement[/b] - Now uses Controller Direction

Mission Goals are shown longer and now be cleared by pressing the Menu button.

Added auto-pause when you pull up the Steam system overlay. 

Added Quit Button enabling you to easily close the game from the main menu.

[b]New Demo Mode[/b] - The desktop view will follow different AI through the city as they battle it out. In VR view you can move about freely and observe but the robots will ignore you.

Guitar in Apartment is now playable.

We've separate out nighttime mode from Halloween giving you the option to play either way.

Numerous other enhancements.

UPDATE: We found an issue in the v0.0.8 release which was impeding climbing. We've issued a small patch which addresses that.

notes.title: What's New in Version 0.0.7
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Halloween[/h1]
We've added a nighttime mode with a special limited-time Halloween theme, just for the holiday. Enjoy!

[b]Nighttime Mode[/b]
Plunge the city into darkness for a whole new experience playable throughout the all game modes. Simply shoot the jack-o-lantern in the main menu to activate it. 

[b]Touchpad Movement[/b]
Allow Modification of Touchpad/DPad movement speed through the Options menu. The speed is still proportional to where on the touchpad you touch, but this allows you set the maximum speed to suit your comfort preference. Of course, teleport only is still available. We've also re-enable teleport movement on the touchpad controller hand. 

Numerous Performance Improvements

notes.title: What’s New in Version 0.0.6
notes.content:
[h1]IMPORTANT CHANGE[/h1]
The weapon switch function has been moved to the menu button. Instead of reaching behind your back, simply press the menu button to change weapons. To pause the game, hold the menu button.

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a Jetpack - the new jetpack allows you to take to the skies to move through the city with incredible speed and agility. 
[*]Added touchpad movement option. Configure via the options menu for either left or right hand. You can still use the teleport feature on the other hand allowing you to pull in objects or move up onto buildings.
[*]Restored Cinematic Spectator option. This turns on a mode that allows spectators to view the action via a third-person camera. NOTE: It does use significantly more GPU resources, so if you are running into performance limits, you may not want to use it.
[*]Added the ability to selectively enable weapons for each hand. This dramatically reduces the time to switch weapons.
[*]Updated the HUD display to better convey messages and level ends stats.
[*]Improved player projectile appearance and speed, making it easier to target enemies.
[*]Adjusted difficulty across all levels.  
[*]Added additional allies to help in the fight.
[*]Made weapons available on earlier levels
[*]Added the ability to pick-up objects using the grip buttons on your controller. Pick-up and throw cars and debris from around the level. At the moment these can only be used as shields, not weapons against the robots, but that feature is planned.
[*]You can now fall if you step off buildings or items. If you have the stomach for it try jumping off a skyscraper. Currently there is no damage assessed. 
[*]Added Camera Mode - When in pause menu - select the camera icon to hide the UI. This makes it easier to take screenshots.
[*]Toned-down weapons effects.
[*]Added a Help Guide
[*]Miscellaneous bug-fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]
